records.statement: Safety Gate must remain separate from measured performance and can block automated training handoff when clarification is needed.
records.applies_to: Apparently healthy adults using the SportRX prototype.
allowed_language: Safety Gate is separate from performance scoring.
Clarify this information before automated training handoff.
disallowed_language: You are medically cleared.
Your medical risk is X percent.
records.limitations: SportRX is not a diagnostic or medical-clearance system.

records.statement: General adult activity targets can be presented as a health reference, not a sport-readiness threshold.
records.applies_to: Adults receiving health-oriented activity context.
allowed_language: General adult activity guidance is a health reference point.
It is not a HYROX readiness score.
disallowed_language: Meeting the guideline means you are ready to race.
records.limitations: Public-health guidance does not determine an individual training dose or performance outcome.

records.statement: FITT-VP can structure a conservative aerobic training handoff within SportRX's apparently healthy adult scope.
records.applies_to: Apparently healthy adults who pass Safety Gate handoff.
allowed_language: Frequency, intensity, time and progression are explicit in this starting block.
disallowed_language: This plan is proven to improve your race result.
records.limitations: FITT-VP is a structure, not validation of a SportRX-specific plan or sport outcome.

records.statement: RPE and session-RPE are practical subjective inputs for communicating intensity and reviewing training load.
records.applies_to: Recreational adults with or without heart-rate devices.
allowed_language: Use RPE to describe how hard the session felt.
RPE is reviewed with completion and context.
disallowed_language: RPE proves fitness improved.
Low RPE means low injury risk.
records.limitations: RPE is subjective and cannot independently validate physiology, safety, or future dose.

records.statement: Missing performance results must remain Not tested and must not be replaced by synthetic values.
records.applies_to: Any incomplete SportRX Benchmark component.
allowed_language: This area is Not tested.
disallowed_language: We estimated your score from the average athlete.
records.limitations: This is a SportRX measurement-integrity rule; it is not a population norm.

records.statement: At least two measured performance dimensions are required before comparing strongest area and what needs work.
records.applies_to: SportRX Training Profile with performance measurements.
allowed_language: At least two measured areas are needed before a comparison.
disallowed_language: Your weakest area is known from one test.
records.limitations: The two-dimension threshold is a conservative SportRX rule and requires pilot validation.

records.statement: A HYROX-style training profile can describe running, aerobic base, strength endurance, station exposure and work capacity as relevant domains.
records.applies_to: People exploring HYROX or hybrid-race preparation.
allowed_language: HYROX-style preparation appears to involve running and station capacity.
disallowed_language: This profile predicts your HYROX result.
records.limitations: The event-specific evidence base is emerging and does not validate SportRX categories or prediction.

records.statement: Recent observable training behavior is a more auditable Quick Match input than subjective fitness sliders.
records.applies_to: Quick Match onboarding before formal testing.
allowed_language: This is a coarse current training fit based on recent activity.
disallowed_language: This is a measured performance result.
records.limitations: Quick Match is not a performance measurement or validated classification.

records.statement: SportRX Hybrid Benchmark v1 stores raw measurements and supports like-for-like retest; it is not a validated aggregate score.
records.applies_to: Standard and low-equipment Benchmark paths.
allowed_language: This Benchmark records raw results first and supports retest.
disallowed_language: Your Benchmark score is validated.
You are above average.
records.limitations: SportRX has no validated cutoffs, norms, or sport-outcome model.

records.statement: Benchmark interpretation requires predefined setup, order, stop rules, raw units and retest notes.
records.applies_to: Any SportRX Benchmark session.
allowed_language: Use the same setup, equipment and protocol version when retesting.
disallowed_language: Different test setups are directly comparable.
records.limitations: Protocol discipline improves interpretability but does not validate cutoffs.

records.statement: A Benchmark session should preserve raw component results, units, RPE, equipment, substitutions, protocol version and notes before interpretation.
records.applies_to: Completed and incomplete SportRX Benchmark sessions.
allowed_language: Raw results and test context are recorded before interpretation.
disallowed_language: A missing unit can be converted into a standard score.
records.limitations: Structured logging supports future validation but is not validation itself.

records.statement: Raw Benchmark results may update a profile only when the value, unit and modality map directly to an existing measured field.
records.applies_to: Benchmark Log import into Training Profile.
allowed_language: This raw result maps directly to a measured area.
disallowed_language: Rounds or mixed work can be converted into an equivalent score without a documented rule.
records.limitations: SportRX does not synthesize unmatched raw data into performance scores.

records.statement: Import compatibility should be visible before saving so direct mappings, missing details and raw-only results remain distinct.
records.applies_to: Benchmark Log review flow.
allowed_language: This result is importable, needs detail, or remains raw-only.
disallowed_language: All training data are equivalent.
records.limitations: Compatibility is a data-quality label, not a performance judgement.

records.statement: When measured data are insufficient to identify a meaningful gap, SportRX must route the user to Benchmark rather than generate a tailored Starter Path.
records.applies_to: Training Profile with fewer than two comparable measured dimensions or unresolved ties.
allowed_language: Complete the Benchmark before receiving a tailored Starter Path.
disallowed_language: We can tailor your path from untested areas.
records.limitations: This protects measurement integrity; it does not prove the route improves outcomes.

records.statement: When a measured station or strength-endurance gap is identified, controlled station-specific strength-endurance work is a reasonable conservative Starter Path focus.
records.applies_to: Users with enough comparable measured data and no Safety Gate block.
allowed_language: A reasonable starting focus is controlled station-specific strength endurance.
disallowed_language: This focus guarantees HYROX improvement.
records.limitations: This is a conservative training focus, not a validated personal outcome plan.

records.statement: When a measured running or aerobic gap is identified, repeatable aerobic running volume is a reasonable conservative Starter Path focus.
records.applies_to: Users with enough comparable measured data and no Safety Gate block.
allowed_language: A reasonable starting focus is repeatable aerobic running volume.
disallowed_language: This volume predicts race completion.
records.limitations: Avoid race-specific intensity prescription without sufficient measured data and validation.

records.statement: SportRX blocks finish-time prediction, personal injury-risk percentages, fake percentiles and validated-readiness claims.
records.applies_to: All SportRX public and internal user-facing outputs.
allowed_language: SportRX does not provide this prediction or percentage.
disallowed_language: You have an X percent chance of finishing.
Your injury risk is low.
Your percentile is X.
records.limitations: These claims require larger, appropriate datasets and formal validation; they are not enabled by citations alone.

records.statement: A 1,000 m adult field test can be recorded as a raw, repeatable time only when its test type and testing context are preserved.
records.applies_to: SportRX 1 km run or low-equipment 1 km option.
allowed_language: Repeat this same 1 km test with the same route or treadmill, surface, incline, warm-up and timing method.
disallowed_language: A 1 km run and a 6-minute result are interchangeable.
This 1 km result has a SportRX norm or validated score.
records.limitations: The direct study was a walk-run protocol in one adult population; SportRX hard-run and local conditions remain only partially supported.

records.statement: A standardized 6-minute adult run can support raw, like-for-like retest, while SportRX run/walk remains a broader partial-evidence option.
records.applies_to: SportRX low-equipment 6-minute run or run/walk option.
allowed_language: Keep the 6-minute test variant and its route or treadmill context unchanged for retest.
disallowed_language: A run/walk has the same validation or reference values as a continuous run.
Convert a 6-minute distance into a 1 km time.
records.limitations: SportRX does not use the study's reference equations and does not validate unrestricted run/walk performance.

records.statement: RowErg and SkiErg 1 km results should be preserved as device-specific personal records with machine, setting, familiarization, order, raw time and RPE context.
records.applies_to: SportRX RowErg or SkiErg 1 km component.
allowed_language: Retest on the same erg type and document model and drag factor or setting.
disallowed_language: RowErg and SkiErg times are directly interchangeable.
This result gives a recreational-athlete percentile or HYROX prediction.
records.limitations: Direct evidence is narrow by device, distance and population. No SportRX ergometer norm, cross-machine conversion or minimal-change threshold is enabled.

records.statement: SportRX station circuits are experimental protocols that preserve their movement standard, load, sequence, rest rule, raw result and RPE without an aggregate score.
records.applies_to: SportRX standard and low-equipment station-circuit components.
allowed_language: This is an experimental SportRX circuit recorded for personal protocol-consistent retest.
disallowed_language: This circuit is a validated standardized performance test.
This circuit score predicts HYROX performance.
records.limitations: No direct validation study supports the SportRX circuit design, scoring, reliability, minimal detectable change or event prediction.

records.statement: SportRX fatigue-after-circuit running and transition blocks are experimental raw-record protocols, not validated fatigue tests.
records.applies_to: SportRX compromised 400 m run and low-equipment transition practice.
allowed_language: Record the preceding station circuit, route, surface, timing method, raw time and RPE; compare only the same protocol context.
disallowed_language: This fatigue-after-circuit run has a validated change threshold or race prediction meaning.
records.limitations: No direct validation supports the SportRX sequence, fatigue effect, score, minimum meaningful change or event inference.

records.statement: Protocol context must be captured with a raw measurement so a future retest can identify a context change rather than overinterpret a numeric difference.
records.applies_to: All completed SportRX Benchmark components.
allowed_language: A route, machine or protocol-context change makes the retest contextual rather than directly comparable.
disallowed_language: A different protocol is directly comparable because both results have the same unit.
records.limitations: Context capture improves auditability; it does not establish a SportRX minimal detectable change.

records.statement: Chinese national physical-fitness materials may be used as a terminology and method-boundary reference without importing official grades, composite scores or norms into SportRX.
records.applies_to: Chinese SportRX public documentation and local measurement wording.
allowed_language: SportRX references local measurement terminology and boundaries only.
disallowed_language: Your SportRX result is an official national fitness grade.
SportRX uses national norms for this hybrid benchmark.
records.limitations: The national standard and SportRX Hybrid Benchmark differ in purpose and protocol; no score mapping is made.
